title: Earth embeddings are decomposable records of the land surface
abstract: arXiv:2610.32617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ecological monitoring, carbon accounting and biodiversity assessment increasingly rely on annual Earth embeddings--learned vectors that compress a year of satellite observation for every ten-meter pixel on Earth, consumed in place of the imagery itself. What these vectors mean has not been established. Here we decompose two widely used embedding products and show that they contain individual ecological features, including fire, forest clearing and crop type, validated against independent reference data on events across six continents. The recovered concepts date abrupt canopy loss to the first post-disturbance growing season and resolve severity well enough to separate prescribed fire from wildfire. Small fires that recover quickly are detectable in one product but not the other, which instead separates crops more strongly.

translated_title: 地球嵌入向量是陆地表面的可分解记录
translated_abstract: 生态监测、碳核算和生物多样性评估日益依赖于年度地球嵌入向量——这是一种通过学习得到的向量，将地球上每个十米像素一整年的卫星观测信息压缩其中，用以替代原始影像本身。然而，这些向量的含义至今尚未被确立。本文对两种广泛使用的嵌入产品进行了分解，并表明它们包含可单独识别的生态特征，包括火灾、森林砍伐和作物类型，并通过来自六大洲事件的独立参考数据进行了验证。所恢复出的概念能够将突然的冠层损失定位于扰动后的第一个生长季，且对严重程度的分辨能力足以区分计划烧除与野火。快速恢复的小型火灾可以在其中一种产品中被检测到，而在另一种产品中则无法检测到，后者反而对作物类型的区分能力更强。
tldr: 本研究首次分解了两种广泛使用的年度地球嵌入向量产品，证明其中包含火灾、森林砍伐和作物类型等可独立验证的生态特征，并能定位扰动发生时间及区分火灾严重程度。
en_tdlr: This study decomposes two widely used annual Earth embedding products, showing they contain individually verifiable ecological features such as fire, forest clearing, and crop type, and can date disturbances and distinguish fire severity.
